notes: AN INSTITUTION'S TYPE IS NOT A STRATEGY. 'Federal Credit Union' appears in the verified-advertiser line of essentially every credit-union ad; counting it as member-owned positioning produces a message gap against a competitor who never chose to say anything. It lands in `unclassified`, not in claims.
